creator: Operator
scope: Six original authored building rotation masters; edits of this project's existing south/front masters. No Core, DLC or other mod assets copied.
sourceInspection: The existing RR_GateConsole, RR_UtilityGenerator and RR_FieldAnalysisBench masters were each viewed before generation. Every generated result was inspected inline.
sourceOrientation: The unsuffixed original master remains the south/front reference. North is an authored rear view; east is an authored side view. West can mirror east in the consumer.
integration: Root owns Def Graphic_Multi/rotatable changes, package allowlist, cutter invocation, build and owner-launched acceptance. This task saved source masters only.
limitations: Original equipment masters use stylized elevated front views. These new facings match that presentation; consistent world scale, drawer/operator-side alignment and native shadows require owner-launched visual acceptance.
The north bench shows rear terminal/recorder housings, with near-edge drawer/cabinet details retained in the generated view. Review that cabinet appearance alongside the original south view in-game.

assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the referenced original Rimrooms equipment sprite, preserve its exact object design, industrial charcoal/off-white/muted amber palette, panel proportions, original worn metal, dark firm outlines and simplified hand-painted RimWorld 1.6 game-sprite style. Draw a genuinely authored alternative physical facing of the SAME object, not a rotated or mirrored image and not a redesign. One isolated object only, high overhead orthographic colony-sim camera with a small visible near-side elevation. Genuine alpha transparent background, generous transparent padding, no ground, no scenery, no floor, no people, no words, no logo, no watermark, no cast shadow outside the object. Same top-lighting and equipment identity. Square master PNG, sprite must read clearly when reduced to the stated footprint. Requested NORTH/back facing, one-cell console. The console's operator/front control face points toward TOP/north of the image, away from the viewer at bottom. Show its real charcoal rear service panel on the near/bottom side with screws and cooling slots instead of the front green screen, red lever and yellow controls. Keep the SAME off-white sloped housing, dark upper ventilation unit, and original heavy side cable routed on its physically opposite side after turning. The front screen must not be drawn on the rear panel. Preserve the compact vertical-housing silhouette.
